about: Every decision in graph.json about schools: who decided, when published, when it takes effect, the exact address, the time read, fact or evidence. Generated from graph.json by incident.researcher@web-summit.dinis; graph.json is the source of truth.

decisions.decision: Schools close on Wednesday: measure (a) of the alert declaration ("encerramento dos estabelecimentos de ensino")
decisions.effect_note: "entre as 00h00 e as 23h59 de 11 de novembro" (the declaration)
decisions.label: fact
decisions.note: Announced at about 09:17 (minister, ANEPC press conference); the declaration published at 12:10 on portugal.gov.pt. Before 01:00Z on 11 Nov this edge carried only 12:10 (the page time), which put the announcement 3 h late (question raised by incident.conductor@ from incident.media@'s live entries). In force from 00:00 (Lusa, 00:09).

decisions.decision: Madeira schools closed on Wednesday morning, reopening from 13:00
decisions.effect_note: hours not stated for the start ("durante a manhã"); end "a partir das 13h de dia 11 de novembro"
decisions.label: evidence
decisions.note: Announced at a regional press conference by the president of the regional civil protection service (Observador 12:11:17, JSON-LD); DNOTICIAS headline 11:26 "Escolas da Madeira encerradas na manhã de quarta-feira até às 13 horas" (a search summary attributes it to the regional government). Most critical hours given as 21:00 to 06:00 (IPMA Madeira at the same conference).
